# FLR outputs

| Output | Function | Class |
|---|---|---|
| catch, discards by fleet | `ss3_catch()`, `ss3_discards()` | `FLQuants` |
| indices | `ss3_indices()` | `FLIndices` (`FLIndexBiomass`) |
| length, age compositions | `ss3_lencomp()`, `ss3_agecomp()` | `FLQuants` |
| OSA / Pearson residuals | `ss3_resid()` | `FLQuants` |
| life history | `ss3_lhpar()` | `FLPar` (unit by sex) |
| selectivity, retention | `ss3_sel()` | `FLQuants` |
| F-at-age by fleet | `ss3_fa()` | `FLQuants` (age, year, unit, season, area) |
| partial F | `ss3_partialF()` | `FLQuants` (total F as attribute) |
| stock by area | `ss3_byarea()`; `ss3stk(area = TRUE)` | `FLQuants`; `FLStocks` |
| stock status | `ss3stk()` | `FLStockR` (`@refpts`) |
| retrospective peels | `ss3_retro()` | `FLStocks` |
| key quantities | `ss3_flqs()` | `FLQuants` |
| MVLN draws | `ss3mvln()$flqs`, `ss3_flqs(mvln)` | `FLQuants` with iterations |

`long2flq()`, `long2flqs()` and `flqs2long()` convert between the long tables and FLR objects. The stock objects
work with FLRef and ggplotFL:

```{r flr, eval = requireNamespace("ggplotFL", quietly = TRUE)}
library(ggplotFL)
plot(ss3_flqs(ss3stk(ss3sma), c("SSB", "F", "Catch")))
```

## MVLN draws as FLQuants with iterations

`ss3mvln()` returns the draws as `FLQuants` with one iteration per draw (`$flqs`): SSB, F, recruitment, catch,
B/Btgt and F/Ftgt, and B/B0 and Catch/MSY where the reference points are reported. `ss3_flqs()` selects
quantities from it, and `ss3plot_flqs()` plots the median with 50% and 90% bands, with the ratio panels named after
the benchmark and a few single draws ("worms") if wanted:

```{r flr-mvln, fig.height = 6, fig.width = 9}
mv <- ss3mvln(ss3sma, mc = 1000)              # joint MVLN draws
names(mv$flqs)
dim(mv$flqs$SSB)                              # 1000 iterations
ss3plot_flqs(ss3_flqs(mv, c("SSB", "F", "B/Btgt", "F/Ftgt")),worms=5)
```

The year-by-year delta-MVLN draws (`method = "annual"`) as FLQuants, for Pandalus with the B30 and F30 targets:

```{r flr-mvln-pra, fig.height = 6, fig.width = 9}
mp <- ss3mvln(pra, mc = 1000, method = "annual")
ss3plot_flqs(ss3_flqs(mp, c("SSB", "Rec", "B/Btgt", "F/Ftgt")),worms=100)
```

The same FLQuants come from the stock with iterations, `ss3_flqs(ss3stk(ss3sma, output = "iters"))`, and work
with ggplotFL (`plot(mv$flqs)`).
